docker_intro: On Linux you choose between three routes: the Ubuntu package for a normal desktop PC, the Docker container for a PC with an NVIDIA graphics card, or the container on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin. After installation, setup continues in your browser, just like on Windows and Mac.
docker_route_nvidia_host: Linux PC with an NVIDIA graphics card
docker_deb_1: Download AI-Detector-<version>-linux-amd64.deb from the latest release on GitHub.
docker_deb_2: Open a terminal and install the package with the commands below. Or double-click the file and choose Install in App Center.
docker_deb_3: Open AI Detector from the app menu. Setup opens in your browser. The package also adds a login entry, so AI Detector starts by itself when you log in.
docker_deb_4: Switch off automatic suspend: Settings → Power → Automatic Suspend → Off. Otherwise Ubuntu puts the PC to sleep and detection stops.
docker_deb_update: Updating: download the new .deb and install it the same way. Your settings and recordings stay in ~/.local/share/ai-detector.
docker_nvidia_title: Route B — Docker on a PC with an NVIDIA GPU
docker_nvidia_req: First install the NVIDIA driver, Docker Engine and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit. Then download the project and start the container:
docker_nvidia_open: Open http://<computer-IP>/ in your browser. Settings, models and recordings are stored in the example folder, next to the Compose file.
docker_jetson_flash_1: Download the JetPack 7.2 image from the NVIDIA website.
docker_jetson_flash_2: Write the image to an SD card or SSD with BalenaEtcher, or install it with NVIDIA SDK Manager from a Linux PC (Jetson connected by USB in recovery mode).
docker_jetson_flash_3: Start the Jetson and complete the first configuration.
docker_jetson_flash_note: Remember the username and password you choose well.

docker_open_text: On the computer itself, setup opens at http://localhost/. From a laptop or phone on the same network, go to http://aidetector.local/ or http://<computer-IP>/. Is port 80 already taken? Then the app uses :8080 (or the next free number).
docker_download_desc: Download the Ubuntu package (.deb) from the latest release. For Docker and Jetson no download is needed.
